name: Loli Loli Paradise
original_name: ろりろり　ぱらだいす
source:
The main character spends all his time at his part time job as a janitor at a sports gym. The gym is full of cute girls who go to the gymnastics classes and swimming classes there. Temptation gets the best of him and he starts to reach out for their little bodies.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ035169.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
男主角把所有时间都泡在了体育馆清洁工的兼职工作上。这家体育馆里随处可见前来参加体操班和游泳班的可爱小女孩。最终，不敌诱惑的他向她们稚嫩娇小的身躯伸出了魔爪。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ035169.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
